description:
Create a new wallet for the agent with a generated BIP39 24-word mnemonic.
The wallet is encrypted locally and stored in ~/.aibtc/.
IMPORTANT: Save the mnemonic securely - it will only be shown once!

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

network.description: Network for the wallet (default: current network)

password.description: Password to protect the wallet (minimum 8 characters) - WARNING: sensitive value

name: wallet_create
